summary: Frontend E2E test (Playwright, 1920x1080) of Contract Management Milestone 1: T&Cs approval, customer e-signature, automatic activation, welcome pack and the Contract Coordinator field. Used the cm.* accounts and fictional TEST_m1ui_ data (2 companies, each with a 'sent' quote). PASSED: (1) TermsCard for the Aftersales Manager showed the pending 2026-01-28 .docx row with View PDF and Approve. Approve showed the toast 'Terms 2026-01-28 approved…' and the status changed to 'Approved version 2026-01-28…'. The coordinator sees no approve or upload controls. The finance and coordinator accounts get 403 when they try to approve through the API. (2) Coordinator flow: Record acceptance gave a toast and opened a Draft; Generate gave the toast 'Agreement generated — ready for signature'. In the send form, Submit stays disabled until a name and an email are entered. Sending to signer@example.test showed the toast 'Email NOT delivered — copy the secure link…'. The afs-ag-signature-request card shows 'Email NOT delivered', the /as/<token> link, Copy, 'Resend / new link' and 'Withdraw link'. Action Centre had exactly one item, 'Signature email not delivered: PF-MA-…'; the send-for-signature item was closed. (3) Public /as/<token> page in a logged-out context: as-summary, as-equipment, as-pdf (the API returns application/pdf %PDF) and as-date show today's date automatically. Sign stays disabled until name, a valid email, a drawn signature, authority and consent are all given (a bad email, no drawing, or unticked consent each keep it disabled). Submitting showed as-signed-confirmation, and reloading still shows the confirmation with no sign button. (4) Back in CRM: status is Active automatically. Steps 0–6 are done ('Service plan · 2 visits', 'Billing · 1 invoices'). Step 7 'Welcome pack · not delivered' is correctly not done. afs-ag-welcome-failed has a Resend button; clicking it shows the error toast 'Welcome pack not delivered — …' with no crash. The 'Signed agreement' button opens a blob PDF in a new tab. (5) Withdraw gave the toast 'Signature link withdrawn', and the old link shows as-error 'This link has been withdrawn…'. An invalid token shows as-error 'This link is not valid'. Decline on a fresh link: as-decline-btn → name and reason → confirm → as-declined-confirmation. CRM shows Declined with the reason, and Action Centre shows 'Customer declined agreement'. (6) CRM > Companies as the Aftersales Manager: the Contract Coordinator select lists Shared queue, Casey and Alex. Changing it shows the toast 'Contract Coordinator: Casey Coordinator · 1 open task(s) reassigned', and the choice persists after reload. 'Shared coordinator queue' clears it with a toast. The Sales Manager sees only the read-only company-coordinator-name. (7) Service compliance shows the overdue contract. No native alert() appeared and there were no page errors anywhere in the agreement or sign flow. FOUND: one medium UI bug (Finance sees a false 'No approved terms' warning) and a few minor items, listed below.

minor.issue: Requires agreements.process, so Finance gets 403. The frontend then shows a false 'No approved terms' warning (see frontend issue). The response also includes the internal storage_path for each terms file, which the UI does not need.

ui_bugs.issue: Finance sees 'No approved terms — agreements cannot be sent…' in red even though 2026-01-28 IS approved. Root cause: GET /terms returns 403 for roles without agreements.process; load() swallows the error (.catch(() => {})) and the default state approved=null renders as 'not approved'. Fix: hide the card when the user lacks agreements.process, or show a neutral or error state when the request fails.
After 'Withdraw link' the status goes back to 'Ready for signature', but step 2 'Sent' still shows as done, because it checks !!ag.signature_request even when the request is revoked.

issues: The Payment method select stays editable after the document is generated, sent or signed. Changing it after the customer has signed could make the data differ from the signed, hashed document. Consider disabling it once status != draft.

action_items: TermsCard: do not show the 'No approved terms' warning when GET /terms fails or returns 403 (Finance). Hide the card or show a neutral message for roles without agreements.process.
AgreementProgress: mark 'Sent' as done only when signature_request is not revoked (or status is in sent/viewed/signed and later).

Use apiMsg(e, …) in acceptQuote and patch (AftersalesApp.js L1764/L1780) and in CoordinatorField save (CRMCompanies.js L1380). They pass e.response.data.detail straight to toast.error, so an object or array detail (e.g. a 409 {code,message} or a 422) could render badly or throw.

The quote-level actions in AgreementsTab still use native alert(): quote PDF (L1669), edit (L1676), versions (L1687/1693/1703), create link (L1712), send quote email (L1727), run follow-ups (L1747). Replace them with toast to match the 'no alert()' rule.
Optional: disable the Payment method select once the agreement is no longer a draft; fix the 'invoices' plural.
critical_code_review_comments: AftersalesApp.js is 3267 lines; split AgreementsTab, AgreementDetail, TermsCard and AgreementProgress into their own modules.
openDetail() has no .catch, so a failed GET of an agreement gives an unhandled rejection and no user feedback.
lastLink is only held in component state. That is intended for security, and the UI explains it with 'use Resend to issue a fresh link'. OK.
PublicAfsAgreementSignPage: the decline name is pre-filled from the shared form state, so 'Confirm decline' is enabled at once. This is acceptable but worth knowing.

Also uploaded and then deleted a temporary terms version TEST_m1ui_v9 (id a80699e2…). All of these were removed by id or prefix afterwards; the agreement/terms PDFs in object storage may remain. The real T&Cs 2026-01-28 was APPROVED during the test (allowed by the brief) and stays approved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seed: cd /app/backend && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && PYTHONPATH=/app/backend python tests/_m1ui_seed.py seed (cleanup with 'cleanup'; also delete crm_audit_log and crm2_notifications by entity/agreement ids). Run python tests/_clear_login_ratelimit.py before logins. Login at /login (gx-login-*) → /contract-management → Contracts → Agreements. Quotes seeded with status 'sent' show afs-quote-accept-<id>. The public sign canvas accepts mouse drag on [data-testid=afs-public-signature-pad]. A headless popup for a blob or PDF tab shows an empty url, so verify PDFs through the API. In the CRM company overview, Account Owner shows only when account_owner_name is set (the test companies have none). The Sales Manager CRM has no Quotes tab because the org is in leisure/Members mode; this is pre-existing (iteration_299).
rca of the issue: Finance false 'No approved terms': the TermsCard renders for every role that can open Agreements, but GET /crm/v2/aftersales/terms is guarded by require_crm_perm('agreements.process'). Finance has no such permission → 403 → the frontend catch does nothing → state stays {approved:null} → red 'No approved terms' text. Reproduce: approve terms as cm.aftersales, log in as cm.finance, open Contracts > Agreements. Fix: gate the card on the permission, or render a distinct error/unknown state.
